run_f_gold: run f_gold to count minimum flips needed to make a binary matrix symmetric
test_f_gold: test f_gold against multiple matrix inputs to verify symmetry flip count results
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to optimize the nested loop comparison of matrix elements
review_f_gold: review f_gold which compares mat[i][j] with mat[j][i] to count asymmetric pairs
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold that returns the number of flips to make a matrix symmetric
